notes.title: Update 0.5.22
notes.notes:
[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
[list] 
[*] This was the biggest change that took the past 6 months to implement.  The game is extremely optimized and runs much smoother.  
[*] Latency and lag is reduced tremendously.  
[*] Servers can now support significantly higher concurrent user counts.  This was a HUGE change that may come with a few bugs that need tidying up, but will ultimately lead to more stable and maintainable servers.  This is where most of the time was spent in order to prepare for the release to additional platforms and mobile.
[*] Matchmaking is much faster.
[*] Private matches start alsmost instantly.
[*] Party system is more stable.
[*] Peak CPU and GPU utilization is reduced by simplifying calculations.
[*] Fixed some issues that were causing screen tearing.
[/list]

[h1]Improved stats progression[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39899378/8d5724e27218d260485293d83f269cf04456f980.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The stats page now shows where the user is ranked relative to the rest of the world as well as your progression between matches.
[/list]

[h1]Change Username[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39899378/9aa533f155ad7a0ad3100b1f6c0a2225aeb9ddea.png[/img]

[list]
[*] You now have the option to change your username in game.
[/list]

[h1]Controller support[/h1]

[list]
[*] We are working towards full controller support.  If you are a controller user, please let us know if you encounter any areas that you cannot navigate on the UI with your controller or if anything strange occurs.  You should also be able to navigate the UI with your arrow keys.
[/list]

[h1]Preview Intel Arc GPU support[/h1]

[i]Note that these only apply to Intel Arc GPUs. AMD and NVIDIA are tested and fully supported on Linux and Windows.[/i]

[list]
[*] We started adding suport for Intel Arc GPUs.  Most features should work on both Windows and Linux but have only been tested on Linux at the moment.
[*] Video recording / match replays are only supported on Linux with Intel Arc.  We plan to add Windows support soon.
[*] Video recording / match replays are currently lower quality than NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.  We are working to improve this.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 0.2.58
notes.notes:
HUGE PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS!!!

Lag should be reduced tremendously!  The back-end had a huge rework.  Many small bugs have been fixed making things much smoother.  Let me know what you guys think!  If nothing stands out as different... that might be a good thing 😉 

Things to note:

- Fixed players not always joining the game.
- Fixed lag from incorrectly predicting inputs.
- Added a loading icon when matchmaking.
- Reduced network traffic.

Keep being awesome you ballers!

notes.title: Update 0.1.17
notes.notes:
[b][u]New Features![/u][/b]

Users are now given blocks for playing games!  This even includes players that don't own the Blocky Pass!

Blocky Pass holders will receive 4 times as many blocks!  Example: If you win, you receive 5 blocks for playing + 20 blocks for winning.  That then gets multiplied by 4 if you have the Blocky Pass resulting in a total of 100 Blocks!

The Blocky Pass is currently on sale for $0.99!

Added in a bad word filter for when users are creating usernames.  If all goes well, we will also create an in game text chat.

Created some cool visuals for displaying the blocks you win at the end of each game.

[u][b]Small Changes[/b][/u]

The "Winners" circle now says "Draw" if the game results in a "Draw".

[u][b]Squashed Bugs![/b][/u]

Fixed errors appearing related to "too many api calls" as the user's friend list grows.  Idk if anyone else besides myself was affected by this (cause I keep adding you guys as friends :) ).  But it should be fixed (or at least reduced) now :).

Fixed the in game settings UI menu not being properly centered.  Sorry about that :/
